name: Gad
overview: Gad is introduced in Scripture as Jacob's seventh son, born to Leah's handmaid Zilpah, with his name meaning 'a troop' or 'company,' indicating strength and numbers (Genesis 30:11; 35:26). He is the father of a tribe of Israel, with his descendants enumerated during the patriarchal and wilderness periods (Genesis 46:16; Exodus 1:4; Numbers 1:14). The prophecy concerning Gad foretells that although he will face adversity, he will ultimately prevail, reflecting God's sustaining power over His people (Genesis 49:19).
